title: Walmart and Eli Lilly Lift OKXICE Objections to 38
why_it_matters: The growing objection list is narrowing the initial issuer set available to a high-profile U.S. test of onchain stock trading.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Walmart and Eli Lilly Lift OKXICE Objections to 38

OKXICE's October 28 notice adds five issuers, taking disclosed objections to its proposed tokenized-securities venue from 33 to 38.
